mainEntity.name: How long does a typical planting design and installation project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a planting design and installation project varies significantly based on its scope and complexity. A small garden refresh might take a few days for design and another few for installation. Larger, more intricate projects involving extensive landscaping or specialized plant materials could span several weeks for design and multiple weeks for installation. Factors like property size, plant availability, and site preparation needs all influence the timeline. We provide a detailed project schedule after the initial consultation.
